FacturaDirectaAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In FacturaDirecta, open Settings > API and integrations. Copy your company ID and create an API key with contacts, products, invoices, estimates and bills read/write permissions. Paste both below. Connection evidence reads your contacts; check API key returns the granted scopes. A successful read does not verify write permissions.
